epics.title: Knowledge Base Content Collaboration
epics.jtbd: When viewing a document in the Knowledge Base, I want to submit persistent comments and update requests, so that I can collaborate with others on content revisions.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase average document comments to 1.5 per document
requirements: R1: Users can submit persistent comments on documents
R2: Users can send update requests for documents

slices.title: Patch document viewer for comments and update requests
slices.jtbd: When implementing comments and update requests for this epic, I want to patch the existing backend code, so that content revision collaboration is achieved.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an authenticated user viewing a document, When they submit a comment or update request, Then the data is saved and associated with the document.
Given the saved comment, When the document is retrieved, Then the comment is correctly available.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Achieve 99% success rate for comment persistence

epics.title: Knowledge Base Personalization
epics.jtbd: When using the Knowledge Base, I want to save search queries and mark materials as favorites, so that I can quickly access them in subsequent sessions.
epics.tocConstraintRef: User retrieval time for frequently used documents
requirements: R1: Users can save search queries
R2: Users can mark materials as favorites for quick access

slices.title: Patch search and document logic for favorites and saved queries
slices.jtbd: When implementing saved queries and favorites for this epic, I want to patch the existing API to store user preferences, so that personalized quick access is achieved.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an authenticated user, When they save a query or mark a document as favorite, Then the preference is persisted.
Given a persisted preference, When the user starts a new session, Then their saved queries and favorites are retrieved.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Maintain < 100ms latency for retrieving user preferences

epics.title: Dynamic Document Export Services
epics.jtbd: When viewing materials in the Knowledge Base, I want to export and download them as formatted PDF or DOCX files, so that I can easily print or read them offline.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Achieve 99.9% successful generation of PDF and DOCX exports
requirements: R1: Users can export structured documents to PDF
R2: Users can export structured documents to DOCX

slices.title: Patch backend document endpoints for PDF and DOCX export
slices.jtbd: When implementing document export for this epic, I want to patch the existing document delivery code to generate PDF and DOCX formats, so that offline document reading is achieved.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a structured document, When a user clicks export to PDF or DOCX, Then the backend dynamically generates a formatted file.
Given the generated file, When the user downloads it, Then it contains the accurate text and structure of the document.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Ensure export generation time is under 2 seconds

epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase overall system search accuracy by 25%
requirements: R1: Search operations must support typo correction and fuzzy matching

slices.title: Patch existing search API for fuzzy matching and typo tolerance
slices.jtbd: When implementing fuzzy search for this epic, I want to enhance the existing search query logic with typo tolerance, so that robust search query matching is achieved.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a search query with spelling errors, When the search is executed, Then the system employs fuzzy matching to understand the intent.
Given the corrected intent, When documents are queried, Then relevant documents matching the corrected terms are returned.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase search result relevance for misspelled queries by 30%

epics.title: Secure Session and Authentication Management
epics.jtbd: When accessing the Knowledge Base, I want my identity to be securely authenticated and my session managed, so that unauthorized users cannot access sensitive blocks or spoof roles.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce unauthorized role spoofing attempts to 0
epics.tocConstraintRef: System security and access control vulnerability
requirements: R1: System must validate login credentials
R2: System must issue and validate secure JWT session tokens to prevent role spoofing

slices.title: Patch authentication logic to validate credentials and JWTs
slices.jtbd: When implementing secure authentication for this epic, I want to replace header-based role trusts with strict JWT validation, so that unauthorized access prevention is achieved.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a user providing valid credentials, When they log in, Then a secure JWT session token is generated.
Given a subsequent API request, When the JWT token is provided, Then the system securely authorizes the user and ignores any spoofed X-User-Role headers.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Achieve 100% rejection rate for forged headers
